# Pharma Franchise Help

> > Comprehensive guide to starting and operating pharmaceutical businesses in India, from franchise marketing to manufacturing setup.

Pharma Franchise Help provides practical guidance for pharmacy graduates and entrepreneurs entering India's pharmaceutical sector. The site covers regulatory compliance (drug licenses, GST), business models (PCD distributors, third-party manufacturing), and market insights featuring major Indian pharma companies like Sun Pharma, Cipla, and Zydus Cadila.

## Key Topics

- Pharma Franchise & PCD Distributors
- Third-Party Manufacturing
- Drug License & Regulatory Compliance
- GST & Company Registration
- Generic Medicine Marketing
- Wholesale Drug License
- B. Pharmacy Career Paths
- Pharmaceutical Business Startup
- Indian Pharma Companies (Sun Pharma, Cipla, Glenmark, Zydus Cadila, Aurobindo, Torrent)
- Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Setup
- AYUSH & Homeopathic Medicines
- FSSAI & Dietary Supplements
- Pharma Exports (US & Canada)
- Inventory Management

## Starting a Pharmaceutical Business

- [How to A Start Pharma Manufacturing Company?](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/how-to-start-pharma-manufacturing-company): Complete guide to starting pharma manufacturing with licensing & investment
- [How to start a successful Business in Pharmaceutical Sector?](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/how-to-start-successful-business-in-pharmaceutical-sector): Career & business startup guide for B. Pharmacy graduates in pharma
- [How to start Generic Medicine marketing Company?](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/how-to-start-generic-medicine-marketing): Guide to starting generic medicine marketing with GST, drug license & setup
- [How can a B. Pharm Student Start Small Scale Manufacturing Unit?](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/how-can-b-pharma-student-start-small-scale-manufacturing-unit): Startup guide for B. Pharm students: small-scale manufacturing & FSSAI
- [How to Start Homeopathy Medicines Company in India?](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/how-to-start-homoeopathic-medicines): AYUSH compliance guide for starting homeopathic medicines company in India

## Pharma Franchise & Distribution Models

- [Types of Pharma franchise/pcd distributors and marketing persons](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/types-of-pharma-franchisee-marketing): Overview of pharma franchise types and PCD distributor categories in India
- [Best area to start Pharma Franchise Marketing](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/best-area-to-start-pharma-franchise): Territory selection guide for pharma franchise with top company options
- [How to take third party manufacturing unit Franchise of Manufacturing Company?](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/third-party-manufacturing-unit-franchise): Guide to obtaining third-party manufacturing franchise from pharma company
- [Inventory Management in Pharmaceutical Industry](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/inventory-management-in-pharmaceutical-industry): Guide to pharmaceutical inventory & raw material management practices

## Licensing & Regulatory Compliance

- [Do I need two licenses one for whole sale and other for marketing my own drug?](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/do-i-need-two-licenses-one-for-wholesale-and-marketing-company): FAQ on wholesale vs marketing drug licenses for third-party manufacturing
- [Where to take drug license if Company registration is at another place?](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/where-to-take-drug-license-if-company): FAQ on drug license location vs company registration for Mumbai setup
- [Is it compulsory to have distributor to sell my products to retailers?](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/is-it-compulsory-to-have-distributor-to-supply-products-chemist): FAQ on distributor requirements for wholesale pharma retail sales
- [License required to sell Natural Medical Remedies](https://pharmafranchisehelp.com/license-required-to-sell-natural-medical-remedies): Licensing requirements for natural remedies & FSSAI dietary supplements
